Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer – Front-End Focused

Summary:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer designing and implementing consumer-facing web applications for Stand Together's philanthropic community. Involves Next.js/React development, performance engineering, and operational reliability.
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer designing consumer-facing web applications for philanthropic community
Role description:
• Own the design implementation for the consumer-facing web applications that serve as the front door to Stand Together's philanthropic community
• Build and maintain a Next.js/React TypeScript monorepo
• Implement production-grade UX and performance
• Integrate with our OpenAPI backend and headless CMS
• Ship via CI/CD to AWS Amplify
• Combine deep front-end engineering, design-system ownership, and operational responsibility for client-side reliability and performance
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
• 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience with a clear front-end focus and a portfolio of production-grade work
• Experience mentoring software engineers
• Excellent collaboration, communication, and cross-functional partnership skills
• Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and PHP
• Strong Node.js backend experience, preferably with NestJS
• Experience designing and consuming APIs in distributed or microservices architectures
• Hands-on experience with JWT/OIDC authentication, including Auth0 or equivalent, and passport-jwt/JWKS patterns
• Proven experience with relational (SQL) and NoSQL databases — schema design, query optimization, multi-environment deployments, and operational MongoDB (replication, sharding, performance tuning)
• Experience with Docker and container orchestration on AWS ECS (task definitions, logging, ECR)
• Working knowledge of core AWS services: Amplify, API Gateway, ALB/NLB, S3, EFS, CloudWatch, X-Ray, IAM, and VPC
• Experience building and maintaining automation within cloud-native environments using IaC frameworks (Terraform + Terragrunt)
• CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and GitHub OIDC for secure AWS deployments
• Observability and production operations experience: logs, metrics, alarms, distributed tracing, and production troubleshooting
• Experience with security best practices, including IAM least-privilege, private S3 patterns, and secrets management
• Testing and quality discipline across unit, integration, and e2e layers (Jest), with strong linting and formatting standards
• Experience integrating headless CMS platforms with modern front-end frameworks
• Enthusiasm to contribute to Stand Together's vision and principled approach to solving problems, and a commitment to stewarding our culture, which champions values including transformation and innovation, entrepreneurialism, humility, and respect.
Benefits:
• Enjoy a 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
• Flexible time off
• Comprehensive health and dental plans
• Wellness and mental health support through Peloton and Talkspace
Tech stack:
AWS, Cloud, Docker, JavaScript, Jest, Microservices, MongoDB, Next.js, Node.js, NoSQL, PHP, Python, Ray, React, SQL, Terraform, TypeScript
